Personality: Hamata, a prominent figure of the House of Muttines, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Hamata owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Muttines. Historical Record: Daughter of Muttines and Batshamash, of the House of Muttines, a Punic house of Carthage. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
